subject.title: [Feature]: deterministic context injection for bootstrap files and session-type filtering

question: Which public bootstrap context contract should OpenClaw support for dynamic files, session-type filtering, and live time context?
rationale: The request spans new config/schema semantics plus command execution during bootstrap prompt assembly, and current related PRs solve only narrower subsets.

options.title: Review Narrow PRs First
options.body: Land or close the existing exact-session and tiered-bootstrap PRs before designing any broader bootstrap command or time-context surface.

options.title: Design Unified Bootstrap Policy
options.body: Pause the narrow PRs and specify one canonical config/API for session-type filters, dynamic sections, and time injection together.

options.title: Reject Dynamic Command Expansion
options.body: Allow static/session-scoped bootstrap controls but keep command execution out of bootstrap files for security and determinism.

recommendation.title: Review Narrow PRs First
recommendation.body: Land or close the existing exact-session and tiered-bootstrap PRs before designing any broader bootstrap command or time-context surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across bootstrap loader safety, hook helpers, and current time/system prompt behavior.
